subject: Post-discovery: Finova throughput & latency sizing call
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@finova.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: Finova throughput & latency sizing call

Hi Jordan / Priya,

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn more about how Finova plans to embed real-time document summarization across customer support workflows. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Discovery highlights (from our call):
  - Target use case: automated summarization & entity extraction on inbound support docs (PDFs, emails)
  - Expected peak concurrency: ~150 concurrent requests during EOD batch windows; steady-state 20–40qps
  - Typical context length: 2k–6k tokens; some long-form docs up to ~20k tokens (we'll scope truncation/streaming)
  - Latency target: P95 <= 400ms for interactive hits; background batch can be relaxed

Next steps I propose:
1) Dedicated capacity sizing call (30–45m) — deep dive on throughput, P95 targets, and pooling/kv-cache expectations so we can prepare a model/config recommendation and an initial cost estimate.
2) Please fill out the attached sizing template with any additional traffic patterns + sample doc sizes.
3) We'll bring Marcus (serving runtime lead) to the sizing call; he can map load patterns to GPU footprints and suggest batching/quantization tradeoffs.

Availability: here are a few slots on my side next week — if any fit, pick one and I'll send a calendar invite. 
- Tue Jan 19: 10:00–10:45 PT or 15:00–15:45 PT
- Wed Jan 20: 08:30–09:15 PT or 13:00–13:45 PT
Or use this link to pick: https://calendly.com/redwood/finova-sizing-30m

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx (fillable sizing worksheet), network-requirements.pdf (VPC & peering checklist).

If you prefer a shorter technical demo before the sizing call, we can add a 15m systems walkthrough — let me know.

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
https://redwood.com/team/stephanie

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@finova.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Finova throughput & latency sizing call

Stephanie —

Appreciate the follow-up and the clear recap. We're excited to move forward. A couple quick clarifications before we schedule the sizing deep dive:

- The 150 concurrent number reflects peak during nightly batch processing (8–10pm ET). For live agent assists, we anticipate up to 30 concurrent users across support teams.
- P95 target of 400ms is correct for interactive flow; for batch processing we can accept up to ~2s.

I'm happy with the proposed participants — Marcus's presence will be useful.

Open slots on our side:
- Tue Jan 19: 10:00–10:45 PT works for both me and Priya.
- If anything shifts, we can also do Wed Jan 20 at 13:00 PT.

I'll populate the sizing worksheet with current qps and document-size histograms and drop it back to you before the call.

Thanks — sending a calendar hold for Tue 10:00 PT.

Jordan Lee
Head of Platform Engineering | Finova
jordan.lee@finova.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@finova.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Post-discovery: Finova throughput & latency sizing call

Stephanie / Jordan —

I can join the Tue 19 Jan 10:00 PT slot. To make the sizing call productive, can you confirm if you can bring:

- A representative sample (CSV) of request arrival timestamps for a 24h window OR histograms for request sizes (tokens).
- Typical concurrency breakdown between interactive vs batch.
- Any hard constraints on GPU types/preferred cloud region or running in Finova VPC (we'll account for network egress and peering).

Prep I'll do on our side before the call:
- Run a rough mapping from your histograms to GPU footprints for 4 model variants (base open model + 2 quantized variants + LLM-optimized variant)
- Provide expected latency vs cost tradeoffs at 20/50/150 concurrent profiles
- A short slide (we'll attach) with recommended batching and prefix-caching configuration patterns

If you can drop the filled worksheet and sample data to the Drive link below before EOD Mon, it will give us time to run quick simulations.
- https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FinovaSizingPreWork

Marcus Lin
Lead, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@finova.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 16:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Finova throughput & latency sizing call

Thanks — Tue Jan 19 10:00 PT is confirmed for Jordan, Priya, and our infra lead.

One more item to flag for the agenda: we have an internal P95 SLA requirement at 350ms for interactive support flows (tightening from our prior estimate). If you can include a short section on how Redwood would test and validate P95 under realistic arrival patterns, that'd be helpful.

I've uploaded a small sample (sanitized) event histogram and a 24h arrival CSV to the Drive folder Marcus shared. File names:
- finova_sample_histogram.csv
- finova_24h_arrival_timestamps.csv

Jordan
